newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungarian forint ends weaker vs dollar.
newsitem.headline: Hungarian forint ends weaker vs dollar.

text.p: The forint ended weaker against the dollar as trade picked up in the afternoon after a slow start, dealers said on Thursday.
The Hungarian unit tracked the dollar/mark ending at 165.45/50, compared to its opening of 165.05/15.
"The dollar/mark went up and down today and the forint went with it," said Gabor Butor of Unicbank.

On the Budapest Commodities Exchange's currency futures section, turnover was a very low at 739 million forints, with Swiss franc futures again the most popular after almost a week of continued interest.
